lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary grid of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs is visible posterior to the gill slits. These are organized into approximately five vertical columns and four horizontal rows, forming a stable arrangement of local intensity maxima across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of white blobs, creating a lattice-like visual structure where the blobs act as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from a high-intensity highlight on the dorsal edge to a deep shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette of a commensal organism is attached to the upper longitudinal ridge in the posterior region of the visible flank.
